title: browse_market
description: Pyfa's market tree: market groups (English/Chinese names) with item counts, the items of a group (meta group, meta level, tech level, slot), optionally only some meta groups (Pyfa's meta buttons: Tech I, Tech II, Faction, Storyline, Deadspace, Officer, Abyssal…). Without `group` it lists the root groups. Give `type` instead to get an item's market path and its variations (meta family: T1, T2, faction, deadspace, officer…) for meta swaps. Only fitting-relevant items are in the dataset; empty groups are hidden unless include_empty.

group.description: market group id, name, or path like 'Ship Equipment/Turrets & Launchers/Projectile Turrets'

type.description: an item (id or name): return its market path and variations instead

depth.description: sub-group levels to expand (default 0: direct children only)

meta_groups.description: only items of these meta groups, e.g. ['Tech II','Faction']
